newsitem.title: UK: Conoco boosts share in North Sea gas fields.
newsitem.headline: Conoco boosts share in North Sea gas fields.

text.p: Conoco boosted its holdings in the Vulcan and South Valiant gas fields in the North Sea by buying the interests of Marathon Oil U.K., Conoco said on Thursday.
Conoco's share in Vulcan was lifted to 42.125 percent and to 37.5 percent in South Valiant, the company, which is the operator of both fields, said.
Terms of the deal, which was approved by the Deparment of Trade and Industry, were not disclosed.
The fields are in the south North Sea off the east England coast and gas is piped to the Theddleshorpe gas terminal in Lincolnshire.
Other interests in the fields are held by British Petroleum, ARCO and CanadianOxy.
